title: Claude Code MCP Tool Description Cap (2KB) — v2.1.84
description: Claude Code v2.1.84 automatically caps MCP tool descriptions and server-level instruction text at 2KB per tool/server. Prevents OpenAPI-generated MCP servers from bloating context with verbose auto-generated documentation (parameter schemas, response examples, exhaustive parameter descriptions). No configuration required — enforced at the protocol layer after tool loading/selection. Orthogonal to Tool Search Tool (deferred loading) and disabledMcpjsonServers (full exclusion).
notes: Native Claude Code feature (v2.1.84). Automatic — no configuration needed. Primary use case: OpenAPI-generated MCP servers that include verbose auto-documentation per tool. Most of our existing MCPs (brave-search, exa, playwright, event-bus, discord) likely already fit within 2KB per tool description. High relevance score expected given: (1) zero integration cost, (2) automatic enforcement, (3) prevents runaway context from future OpenAPI-backed MCPs, (4) official Anthropic feature. Candidate for Token Efficiency section of registry. Should score 70+ (novel automatic protection) vs Tool Search Tool (deferred loading — those are complementary mechanisms, not substitutes).

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature in v2.1.84 requiring zero configuration — it operates automatically at the protocol layer. Integration complexity is 100 (zero config, passive enforcement). Token efficiency is 70: existing MCPs likely already under 2KB, so immediate impact is minor, but provides automatic protection as OpenAPI-backed MCP adoption grows — high forward value. Capability expansion is 70: complements but doesn't duplicate existing token efficiency stack (Tool Search Tool handles deferred loading, disabledMcpjsonServers handles full exclusion — this adds automatic truncation at the description level, a distinct mechanism). Maintenance is 100: zero maintenance, native version-tracked feature. Community validation is 100: official Anthropic release. Action: add to registry Token Efficiency section with v2.1.84 version note and redundancy triggers.
